scope: direct Tier-2 DREAMPlace search on bp_fe, ethernet, and isa_npu with OpenROAD disabled

measured_lessons.observation: Small route_pressure_long perturbations often stayed very close to the WAWL plus bell-density fixed baseline.

best_measured_tradeoff.interpretation: overflow improved slightly while HPWL worsened relative to the strongest fixed baseline

measured_lessons.observation: One calibrated candidate showed a raw Pareto measurement relative to the strongest fixed baseline, but the measured effect was very small and not selected as a discovery.
Electric-density plus pin/RUDY pressure produced large overflow reductions on some cells but much weaker HPWL behavior than the WAWL plus bell-density fixed baseline.

static_failure_patterns: Raw LLM coefficients for route_pressure_long, soft_rudy_pnorm, and pin_density_pnorm were often too large before calibration.
Several later attempts repeated mechanisms already measured as near-misses instead of making a mechanism-level change.
Pin-count-weighted wirelength by itself was too close to the explicit wirelength-density family.
next_search_hint: Use these as measured execution facts. The next objective should explore a mechanism-level change in how routing, pin pressure, and density smoothing interact, instead of only adding a tiny routing perturbation to WAWL plus bell density.
